title: Blood on the Clocktower
description: A modpack containing a collection of mods to create an adaptation of the social deduction game 'Blood on the Clocktower' inside of Minecraft.
body:
![Blood on the Clocktower Logo by Yogscast](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a863254eddf9b94b5053521f4f459404b9a97c5f.png)
# Blood on the Clocktower
Welcome to Blood on the Clocktower, a social deduction game where players take on the roles of townsfolk and demons inside of a dangerous village. The goal? The town must figure out who the demon is and execute them before it's too late.

This modpack contains a collection of mods put together to create a seamless and unique experience.

**Due to the multiplayer nature of Blood on the Clocktower, you are required to insert a server IP. If you wish to access singleplayer you must disable FancyMenu using CTRL + ALT + C**

This modpack is intended to be used with the following map:
https://www.planetminecraft.com/project/blood-on-the-clocktower/

Online tools are available for the Grimoire:
https://clocktower.online/
-or-
https://botc.games/

This modpack is inspired by The Yogscast.

_Blood on the Clocktower is owned by Steven Medway & The Pandemonium Institute, myself (Naidru) and other members listed on this modpack are not affiliated_
